summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return detailing ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. The registrant is buying back its own Class A ordinary shares on-market in multiple tranches between May and June 2026 at prices ranging from ~$6.55 to $7.25 per share, with daily volumes of 0.03%–0.09% of outstanding shares. The shares are being repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled as of the close of each day. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is applicable. This is an issuer tender through open-market share buybacks. Watch for continued repurchase cadence and eventual cancellation impact on share count.
